title: MC /sprint:full — Autonomy Preset Bundle
description: Operator-editable preset bundle for /sprint:full. Three default presets (conservative/moderate/aggressive) shipped at .claude/agents/00-alex/.system/policy/sprint-full-autonomy.json. The orchestrator loads the bundle once at start. hard_ceilings[] is informational only — scripts/sprint/full.js has a hardcoded enum that is authoritative; no preset may bypass it.

presets.description: Map of preset_name -> preset definition. Default presets: conservative, moderate, aggressive.

hard_ceilings.description: Informational read-only enumeration of actions that no preset may pre-authorize. scripts/sprint/full.js hardcodes the authoritative list and refuses to start if any preset attempts to override.

pre_authorized_approval_levels.description: Approval levels (from approval.schema.json) that the orchestrator may auto-record without operator input. production_release_approval and paid_service_approval are FORBIDDEN here — the orchestrator's hardcoded enum rejects bundles that include them.

release_approval_targets.description: When pre_authorized_approval_levels includes release_approval_required, this list bounds WHICH release targets may be auto-approved. production is FORBIDDEN; only staging / internal-canary / dev are allowed.

stop_condition_policy.description: Maps each execute.js stop_reason to the orchestrator's response.

halt_threshold_failed_tickets_pct.description: If percentage of tickets in deferred/abandoned exceeds this threshold during execute phase, halt the orchestrator. 0 disables.

cost_estimate_threshold_usd.description: Soft halt threshold for cumulative LLM-spend estimate (coarse counter). Default 5 matches CLAUDE.md autonomy table. Operator may resume past with --cost-acknowledged (2x lift for that run only).

branch_protection_allow_main.description: If true, --allow-main flag works WITHOUT requiring aggressive preset. Default false. Only aggressive should set this true.

stopAction.description: halt = write halt report + stop; auto_continue = silently proceed (use sparingly); defer = log + skip this ticket, continue to next.
